401-3944-7918-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3944-7918-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-5551-8095.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
1270-5551-8095.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat from step 4.

1734-3175-6495.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
1734-3175-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-5131-7913-8095--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-7913-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Iron Lad.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

567-1981-2415-3967.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
567-1981-2415-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Swordsman triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2060-4415-6930-7646.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1594-3532-5078-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
1594-3532-5078-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

1753-3490-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1753-3490-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2034-3108-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
2034-3108-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

2919-4321-5641-6890.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-4321-5641-6890.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

457-3375-5078-5390.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

2757-5685-6753.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {3}{G}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Eldrazi Spawn, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the basic Forest.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3622-4067-5116-6281.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gravedigger.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Gravedigger that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Gravedigger token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gravedigger from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

2034-5276-6412.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder, adding {C}{C}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Pre-War Formalwear from exile to the battlefield.
When Pre-War Formalwear enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Pre-War Formalwear to it.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Repeat from step 3.

1525-2031-2406-2660-4865.notablePrerequisites:
Vesuvan Shapeshifter is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-4865.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-4865.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

2079-3259-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
2079-3259-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

3946-4572-4935.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1722-2034-2741-3583.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-2741-3583.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

744-2034-3394.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
744-2034-3394.description:
Activate Pegasus Refuge by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Pegasus creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pegasus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Pegasus dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

141-190-370.description:
Cast Gather Specimens by paying {3}{U}{U}{U}, causing all creatures that would be created under an opponent's control this turn to be created under you control instead.
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, targeting any permanent.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Naru Meha enters the battlefield, creating a copy of Fractured Identity, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Fractured Identity, exiling Naru Meha and creating a copy of Naru Meha for each opponent you have.
Put all but one Naru Meha token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Naru Meha token(s) enter the battlefield, creating a copy of Fractured Identity targeting Naru Meha, and any other instants and/or sorceries on the stack.
Repeat from step 5.
You may also have the additional triggers target permanents your opponent control to exile them and create token copies of them.

1651-3263-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Treasure tokens, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating two 1/1 Construct creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Construct tokens, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.

851-1308-3129-3209.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback for {4}{G}, creating eight 1/1 green Saproling token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback, tapping five green 1/1 Saproling tokens to pay for it using convoke.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Carrion Feeder's ability, putting a +1/+1counter on it.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard to the battlefield by paying {B}.
Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and adding {B}.
Repeat.

1964-1987-2510-2556.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1964-1987-2510-2556.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

3966-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to target opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain you 50 life.
Repeat.

738-1202-3370-5256.description:
Sacrifice Myr Moonvessel to Altar of Dementia.
Myr Moonvessel and Butcher of Malakir trigger.
Resolve Myr Moonvessel's trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve Butcher of Malakir's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Myr Moonvessel to your hand.
Resolve Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Cast Myr Moonvessel by paying {1}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
